column2: Do you have a high fever (above 38.5°C)? (yes/no)
Do you have a severe headache? (yes/no)
Do you feel pain behind the eyes? (yes/no)
Have you vomited at least once? (yes/no)
Is the vomiting frequent or continuous? (frequent/continuous/once)
Do you have severe or persistent abdominal pain? (yes/no)
Do you notice any bleeding (nose, gums, vomiting blood, black stool)? (yes/no)
Do you feel extreme weakness or restlessness? (yes/no)

Do you notice ANY of these signs:
• Swelling in hands/feet (rings/shoes feel tight)
• Puffy face or eyes
• Shortness of breath or difficulty lying flat
• Feeling of abdominal fullness/bloating
(yes/no)
